issues.issue: The citation states 'The Division viewed Study 201 as proof-of-concept,' which contradicts using this as the single pivotal/adequate and well-controlled trial and undermines the trial_name field it supports.

The design text calls it a 'dose-finding study' but the supporting Study 201 citation (line 43) does not mention dose-finding; the dose-finding characterization is drawn only from the labeling 'Study 1' quote, creating a mixed identity between Study 201 and Study 1.

The N field mixes identifiers: it labels the cohort as Study 201 in trial_name but the N citation is for 'Study 1' (161 lecanemab / 247 placebo), and these Study 1/Study 201 identifiers are conflated throughout without reconciliation.

Endpoint states the surrogate was measured at Week 79 via PET SUVr; supported by citations, but the primary clinical endpoint (ADCOMS at Week 53) being reported as 'primary' while approval rests on the surrogate should be flagged as potential reader confusion (minor).

ARIA placebo denominator is stated as 5% (13/245) while symptomatic ARIA and other rates use n=161 and the AR table uses placebo n=245 vs elsewhere n=247/245 — inconsistent denominators (247 randomized to placebo per N field vs 245 in safety) are not reconciled.
Field is labeled 'vote' but convened=false and no vote occurred; the text is an explanation for non-referral, so labeling it a vote is a minor mislabel.
